newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore arrests 140 in island-wide drugs bust.
newsitem.headline: Singapore arrests 140 in island-wide drugs bust.

text.p: Singapore's Central Narcotics Bureau (CNB) said on Thursday it had arrested 140 suspected drug abusers in an island-wide swoop on nightspots, bars and cafes.
A CNB spokesman said the round-up had seized heroin, cannabis, Ecstasy, opium and stimulant pills.
Of the 140 people arrested in the 19-hour operation, 63 tested positive for use of illegal drugs. Two of those arrested were suspected of drug-trafficking, he said.

Singapore has tough anti-drug laws including a mandatory death sentence for anyone over 18 years found guilty of trafficking in more than 15 grams (half an ounce) of heroin, 30 grams (an ounce) of morphine or 500 grams (18 oz) of cannabis.
Of the nearly 280 people hanged for various crimes in Singapore since 1975, over half have been for drug-related offences.
